assertion.value: The local ethics committee of Canton Zurich was consulted to assess the need for ethics approval (BASEC-Nr: 2024–01188). According to the ethics committee, this project was not subject to ethics approval given that the research group exclusively processed anonymous data. This is a register-based study where all data are anonymised and thus there is no ability to directly consent patients/participants.
